Mission & Governance

A Platform for Responsible Growth & Global Cooperation

The mission of the International Partnership and Development Association of the Philippines, Inc. (IPDA Philippines) is to foster international cooperation, inclusive economic growth, and sustainable human development.

IPDA represents the interests of investors and serves as a dedicated platform connecting international investors with Philippine government institutions and vetted investment opportunities—operating strictly on a non-profit basis under Philippine law.

Strategic Partner
TradePro Dynamics Corp. (Philippines)

Collaborating with IPDA on international partnerships, healthcare technology transfer, and cross-border investment facilitation across Southeast Asia and BRICS nations.

Core Mandate

Six Pillars of International Partnership

Aligned with IPDA's Articles of Incorporation and By-Laws to deliver measurable economic and social impact in the Philippines and abroad.

Responsible Investment & Trade

Promoting responsible cross-border investment and international trade while representing investor interests across Philippine sectors.

Medical Missions & Health Innovation

Facilitating medical missions, preventive healthcare, rehabilitation, and competency localization in partnership with the BRICS Health Coalition.

Educational Missions & Exchange

Connecting academic and medical-education institutions to share expertise, training programs, and scientific research.

Tourism & Cultural Exchange

Encouraging sustainable tourism and public diplomacy initiatives that strengthen people-to-people ties between nations.

Humanitarian Initiatives

Supporting socially significant community projects and humanitarian partnerships that uplift quality of life.

Government & Institutional Liaison

Serving as a direct bridge between international investors and Philippine government institutions for vetted opportunities.
